d: Trails boss Gil Favor and ramrod Rowdy Yates encounter a stage coach accident while driving their cattle north.
Trail boss Gil Favor sees his crew of cattle drovers seeking release from the tensions of trail life by indulging in a shatteringly violent day off in a tough little frontier town.

st: Incident of the Edge of Madness
d: Bitter overtones of the recent War Between the States harass trail boss Gil Favor and ramrod Rowdy Yates as they push their cattle drive north from Texas.

st: Incident of the Power and the Plow
d: Trail boss Gil Favor and ramrod Rowdy Yates get a taste of the capricious power of Jed Reston, a cattle and land baron, as they drive their herd north.

Trail boss Gil Favor and ramrod Rowdy Yates find themselves involved in a brother's crusade for revenge after one of their trail hands suddenly leaves the cattle drive, as they pass through Barker Springs, and subsequently is shot to death.
Four sisters, headed by Hannah Haley are found huddled around their broken-down show wagon as trail boss Gil Favor and his ramrod drive their cattle north to market.

st: Incident of the Town in Terror
d: Trail boss Gil Favor and his ramrod, Rowdy Yates, face the stalking terror of a life-devouring epidemic that strikes their cattle drive while they are on the open plains.
Trail boss Gil Favor and his ramrod Rowdy Yates find themselves, their crew and their cattle drive the target of a vicious gang of bandits who make the plains their stalking ground.

A massive wind-swept plateau, one of the most difficult passes on the trip north, is the scene of the contest between Gil Favor and Jefferson Devereaux - boss of the country through which the drive is passing.
Gil Favor and his ramrod, Rowdy Yates, leave their cattle drive to hunt a half dozen strays and stumble on a woman and her daughter being held prisoner.
Trail boss Gil Favor faces the roughest test a cattle drover can meet when he takes his herd across the bone-dry staked plains.
Midway across a desert valley with their herd, trail boss Gil Favor and his ramrod Rowdy Yates encounter a cabin in flames and its only survivor, Jenny Watson.

st: Incident of Fear in the Streets
d: Trail boss Gil Favor and his ramrod Rowdy Yates leave the herd and race to a nearby town to find doctor for Pete Nolan, who has been badly gored by a steer.
With their cattle in danger of dying from thirst, trail boss Gil Favor and his ramrod Rowdy Yates face an added threat from tyrant Jesse Hode.

st: Incident of the Burst of Evil
d: The crew or the cattle drive captures a wild looking man who has been stalking their camp on foot.

st: Incident of the Day of the Dead
d: Rowdy Yates performs an act of bravery by rescuing a runaway horse while waiting in town to pick up mail for the cattle drive.
